rows.role_title: Presidente Nacional do Partido dos Trabalhadores
rows.text: The summary sheet of the 10th Encontro (18-20 August 1995, SESC Guarapari) gives the candidates for the PT presidency as José Dirceu, 215 votes (54.02%), and Hamilton Pereira, 183 votes (45.98%), with 16 blank; a note says this was the first contested vote for the party presidency, the president until then having been elected by acclamation on a single slate. Its sources include a table of results prepared by the Secretaria de Organização Nacional.
